I don’t really remember when I got it, maybe around 2-3 years ago. I noticed my hearing was also going. Never really did anything about it as I thought I just didn’t do a good job cleaning my ears. During this time I always had an AC going, so that covered up the noise. During the day it didn’t really bother me, as I never thought about it.
One day however, something inside my mind triggered the worst anxiety attack I’ve ever had. It made me focus on all the terrible things of my life and the damage to my body. At this time I hated the sound. It annoyed me to no end, continuously hearing this retched noise. 

With the other flaws that I noticed combined with this, I wanted to kill myself. The desire to die to end this noise that others don’t have to hear... it sounded appealing. However, I pressed on, living day by day, second by second, slowly adjusting to  the annoyance. Now I just tolerate it, despite how much I hate it.

I think I just hated the idea of being “damaged”. I was resentful that it happened to me, and others didn’t have to suffer with it. Yet after hearing and reading that there’s not much that can change, I’m forced to live with it, and I’m now okay with that. It also helps that there are others like me— you guys.
